item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 13/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will strengthen gradually today. Temperatures over the coast of southern China will fall progressively and it will be windy in the next couple of days. It will be rather cool in the morning and at night. It will be cold over the inland areas. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will also cover the region. With the band of clouds thinning out early to midweek next week, the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong. Daytime temperatures will rise gradually, but it will still be cool in the morning and at night. The monsoon replenishment is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week.
